item.title: Correction · Sandler Neurosciences Center: The Sandler Neurosciences Center page no longer dates…
item.description: The Sandler Neurosciences Center page no longer dates its $208 million project cost. The developer's page prints the figure with no date or description of what it covers. Source: Edgemoor, UCSF Sandler Neurosciences Center project page (edgemoor.com/projects/ucsf-sandler-neurosciences-center).

item.title: Correction · Sandler Neurosciences Center: SOM's page gives 'Design Finish Year 2010' and…
item.description: SOM's page gives 'Design Finish Year 2010' and 'Completion Year 2012' only, so the May 2010 construction start (a misreading of the design year) was removed and the opening is now the year 2012, also listed by Clark Construction. The $200 million cost and occupant counts had rested on a Tradeline article that could not be read; Clark Construction gives about 100 principal investigators and 500+ researchers and staff, and Edgemoor's project page gives a $208 million project cost. The unsourced 'SF office' detail was dropped and the aerial photo caption no longer says 'from a departing flight'. Source: Skidmore, Owings & Merrill, UCSF Sandler Neurosciences Center (https://www.som.com/projects/ucsf-sandler-neurosciences-center/); Clark Construction, UCSF Sandler Neurosciences Center (https://www.clarkconstruction.com/our-work/projects/ucsf-sandler-neurosciences-center); Edgemoor Infrastructure & Real Estate, UCSF Sandler Neurosciences Center (https://www.edgemoor.com/projects/ucsf-sandler-neurosciences-center).
